body:
Both clients. Today, typing part of a name in the Add-item dialog and picking a
suggestion only PREFILLS the form from that item and binds its id; the item
joins the list only after pressing Add. That was a deliberate choice in T-33
(pick no longer persists immediately, so Cancel leaves the item untouched), but
it costs a second press on the overwhelmingly common path.

The usual workflow is: add straight from the backlog. So picking a suggestion
should immediately put that item on the list (status -> todo) and close the
dialog. If the previous settings carried over from the backlog are unwanted,
the item can be edited afterwards.

Notes:
- Only the NAME suggestions behave this way. The category and store chips still
  just fill their field.
- Only in add mode. Edit mode has no name suggestions.
- Adopting writes only what actually changed, i.e. the status clock. Picking an
  item that is already `todo` therefore writes nothing and simply closes.
- This re-reverses the T-33 decision on the pick path, on purpose.
title: Add item: picking a name suggestion adds it straight away
